verdict.rationale: Featurebase documents a broad first-party API: feedback posts, help-center article editing built for AI agents, a Reports API that mirrors the dashboard's Reports section, a Training Data API, an SDK and webhooks. That shows wide API surface, but nothing claims full UI parity, and several UI features have no documented API equivalent. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage evidence for changelogs/roadmap/inbox/workflows/integrations, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Reports API exposes the same analytics engine that powers the Reports section of the Featurebase dashboard.
POST /v2/help_center/articles/{id}/edit_body, a find/replace endpoint for surgical, byte-stable edits – ideal for AI agents renaming a product across many articles.
Returns all posts (feedback submissions) for the authenticated organization.
The Training Data API manages the knowledge available to your customer-support AI agent.
